title: ooRexx Virtual USB durable continuity ledger

records.rule: Current executable baseline is oorexx_virtual_usb_v0.1-dev9.zip SHA-256 efa8a1e5a31a8ae7e39360b5f9495772ef1132dccb620d1a896320d24edbc8f6.
VirtualUsbDevice/FIDO own semantics; providers own transport/native presentation.
FidoTestHost is a synthetic memory-provider host and must not drive LinuxRawGadgetProvider.
Generic HID descriptor/report support belongs to Virtual USB core, not FIDO special casing.
Development personality is USB HID class 03 with FIDO usage page F1D0 and CTAPHID usage 01.
Advertise FIDO_2_0 only; do not imply absent CTAP 2.1+ functionality.
Credential keys/signatures use Ed25519/COSE -8, but deterministic development seed derivation is not production-safe.
Always-present is a development presence provider; physical hardware must supply qualified user-presence semantics.
EP0 host-IN uses WRITE; host-OUT uses READ, including zero-length SET_CONFIGURATION.
OUT endpoint reads are separate activities so blocking transfer IO cannot starve control/reset handling.
raw_gadget/dummy_hcd are target host test substrate; dummy_hcd must match the running kernel.
A matching VID:PID can be stale. Presenter ownership and path+devnum generation identity are mandatory.
The dev8 CAFE:F1D0/no-HID result is invalid provider evidence because the current presenter failed UDC acquisition with EBUSY.
Next live PASS requires current presenter ownership, new CAFE:F1D0 generation, HID class 03 and matching hidraw.
Resolve dependency identity before constructing REXX_PATH/native paths; never select by arbitrary first filesystem match.
FIDO correctness and whole physical USB-device trust are separate claims; expected peripheral personality must be qualified explicitly.
Hardware continuation is a powered SoC/USB device controller running the semantic device; storage holds code/data but is not the active USB device.
Production hardware requires qualified entropy, protected key storage, physical presence and attestation providers.
libfido2 and browser/WebAuthn acceptance are later gates after clean HID/hidraw enumeration.
Dynamic Raw Gadget endpoint assignment remains future portability work for UDCs that cannot satisfy fixed profile addresses.

provenance.claim: Continuity ledger summarizes the current package capabilities, history, qualification boundary and deliberate limitations.
